text: We're so excited to have reached 300 Followers on Instagram! Check out our Insta exclusive post at [https://www.instagram.com/grimmsdetectiveagency/](https://www.instagram.com/grimmsdetectiveagency/)

𝐁𝐋𝐄𝐒𝐒𝐄𝐃 𝐇𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐎𝐖𝐓𝐈𝐃𝐄 - During the Octave of All Saints, from November 1st through the 8th, a plenary indulgence may be obtained by visiting a cemetery and praying for the dead. The indulgence may also be offered to the souls in purgatory. A separate indulgence may be obtained for each day that this is done.

Special thanks to everyone who came and showed their support! Agency Grimm's booth at the 2026 Regina Caeli Fall Festival was a success! We sold out our limited run and sold a lot of merch to boot. It was great speaking with all of you and seeing how much interest there was in the series! Please look forward to the next installment in the lives of the Grimm siblings!

We are proud to announce that **Agency Grimm** is officially partnering with Regina Caeli Parish to host a booth at their **2026 Fall Festival**! We will be sharing a booth with our cohost G.P. at **Booth 12**. For all you Texans out there, come check us out for access to case files, meet-the-author, bookmarks, and all your other merch needs!

***Agency Grimm: Case File A-10541*** is finally out! Join the siblings in their first adventure released to public eyes! Marvel at the menagerie of fairytale creatures! Tremble at the terror of magical beasts! 10% of royalties go to select Catholic charities. Order your copy today at: [https://www.amazon.com/Agency-Grimm-10541-Snooze-Button/dp/B0H8B4CKYR/](https://www.amazon.com/Agency-Grimm-10541-Snooze-Button/dp/B0H8B4CKYR/).
The gnomes are hard at work. Between promo materials, artwork, and final line edits, the book release is later than expected. Full launch on July 10th 💪
Print manuscript is now being formatted. *No Snooze Button for the Wicked* is scheduled to release in 2 weeks - stay tuned!
